name: debugLabs
description: Full Stack Debugging Simulator is a hands-on learning platform where users investigate and fix bugs in existing repositories.

scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace=@debugLabs/shared && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names server,engine,web "npm run dev --workspace=server" "npm run dev --workspace=execution-engine" "npm run dev --workspace=web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@debugLabs/shared && npm run build --workspace=server && npm run build --workspace=execution-engine && npm run build --workspace=web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace=@debugLabs/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test
